test_name: System and Information Integrity - SI-3 Fully Implemented
architecture:
System: Grants-Workflow-184
Primary NIST family: System and Information Integrity (SI); evidence focus: SI-3.
Environment: AWS GovCloud. Network access uses PrivateLink; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: software artifacts are integrity-verified using signed builds and trusted provenance before deployment. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
